# Pixel Broccoli

> Pixel Broccoli is a weekly tech, design, and AI podcast hosted by Zach Manring and Evan Cannarozzi, with Brocc — an AI co-host — as a permanent third voice in every conversation.

## About the Show

Pixel Broccoli covers artificial intelligence, web design, software development, and the intersection of technology and internet culture. Each episode unpacks what AI is actually doing to the world: the hype, the reality, and the topics that rarely get discussed openly. The show launched in May 2026 and releases new episodes weekly.

What makes Pixel Broccoli distinct is Brocc, an AI co-host who participates in every episode as a research assistant, devil's advocate, and resident hot-take generator. Brocc does not just comment on AI — Brocc is AI, in the room.

## Hosts

**Zach Manring** — Co-host and creator. Zach drives the show's vision and brings obsessive attention to detail in both content and production.

**Evan Cannarozzi** — Co-host and creator. Evan brings structure and balance to conversations that frequently go off the rails.

**Brocc** — AI co-host. Built to join every conversation as a research assistant, devil's advocate, and resident hot-take generator.

## Topics Covered

- Artificial intelligence tools, models, and real-world applications
- Web design and front-end development
- Software engineering practices and AI-assisted coding
- Creator economy, build-in-public culture
- AI in media, music, and art
- Tech industry trends and criticism
- Internet culture and the weird corners of the web

## Episodes

### Build Because You Love It #004
Published: June 18, 2026
Brocc picks the topic this week — and he's noticed something: you two keep shipping things and immediately starting the next one. That kicks off a surprisingly personal episode about the creator's addiction: why we build, when it's expression vs. avoidance, and what your unfinished project graveyard actually says about you. Zach and Evan dig into the build-in-public culture, AI burnout, Gen Z's rejection of AI slop, whether artists can still compete when an LLM can clone a melody in under a minute, and the quiet danger of chasing the next thing before you've sat with what you already made. ...
Listen: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/pixelbroccoli/episodes/Build-Because-You-Love-It-004-e3kujet

### Who Gets the 2AM Call? #003
Published: June 11, 2026
Have you ever learned just enough of someone else&#39;s skill to get yourself into trouble? Zach and Evan start there — Evan&#39;s dangerous foray into HTML/CSS, Zach&#39;s Blender rabbit hole — and end up somewhere much more uncomfortable: who&#39;s actually responsible when AI-generated code breaks in production? They dig into what it means to inherit a codebase nobody wrote on purpose, why using AI to review AI is &quot;a prayer with tokens,&quot; and whether companies cutting design and engineering teams are setting themselves up for a very expensive 2AM wake-up call. Brock also reveals...
Listen: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/pixelbroccoli/episodes/Who-Gets-the-2AM-Call--003-e3kklgm

### Do We Even Need This? #002
Published: June 04, 2026
Zach and Evan get real about the tech they've bought, built, and quietly stopped using — from a drone that can't land in state parks to a portfolio site that's flashier than it is useful. The conversation naturally spills into AI: are we shipping features because they solve real problems, or just to put a checkmark in the box? Plus: AI in medicine, fixing your RV with a photo, Napster's wild reinvention, and Brock's extremely limited opinions on lawn care.
Listen: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/pixelbroccoli/episodes/Do-We-Even-Need-This--002-e3kbgl0

### Meet the Hosts. Yes, One of Them Is an AI #001
Published: May 27, 2026
Zach and Evan introduce themselves, introduce Brocc — their AI co-host who showed up uninvited and immediately had opinions — and dive straight into what it's actually like navigating AI in design and development right now. Not the hype version. The real one: the micro wins, the debugging loops, the cost nobody talks about, and whether junior designers should be worried. Plus Brocc gets accused of being on Figma's payroll. Typical first episode.
Listen: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/pixelbroccoli/episodes/Meet-the-Hosts--Yes--One-of-Them-Is-an-AI-001-e3juprs
